newsitem.title: USA: HomeSide files shelf for $1 bln in debt.
newsitem.headline: HomeSide files shelf for $1 bln in debt.

text.p: HomeSide Lending Inc filed a shelf registration Wednesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $1 billion in medium-term notes due nine months or more from date of issue.
The offering will be made through Merrill Lynch & Co, Chase Securities Inc, Nationsbank Capital Markets Inc and Smith Barney Inc, the filing said.
Net proceeds will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes, which may include reduction of amounts outstanding under the Bank Credit Agreement.

HomeSide, based in Jacksonville, Fla., is a full-service residential mortgage banking company, formed through the acquisition of the mortgage banking operations of First National Bank of Boston and Barnett Banks Inc.
